description: COUNTY LEVEL, FREE, FUTURE (next 24 hours to 10 days). ML Storm Forecast by Address. Use when the question is which storms could affect a county soon: counts of addresses in the forecast path, the storm types forecast and the estimated cost (the county's A-F grade is shown as a secondary label). Input is state plus county. Per-peril machine-learning models, refreshed 4 times a day. Could happen, not will. Not for past storms (use get_storm_history, get_address_report or get_property_storm_history_report) and not for current weather (use get_current_weather). The paid pull (addresses=true, $0.05 per address) returns one record per address with structure_value (USD replacement cost), people (estimated occupants), full_address, lat, lon, county, storm_type, forecast_time and risk_label. For the paid pull, call get_weather_data with dataset=risk and addresses=true (needs an Atlas United Data API key or an x402 payment).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

peril.description: Narrows the forecast to one storm type -- check a free preview's storm_types for real values available in this window.
